# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church wasn't a suggestion—it was a battle cry. Notice the order: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. Strength isn't the starting point; it's the result of vigilance and faith. Too many of us roll out of bed and into the day without a plan, reacting to whatever the world throws at us. That's not how warriors live. Warriors rise with intention. They survey the battlefield, plant their feet on the truth of God's Word, and move with purpose.

Your faith is not passive. It's a muscle that grows under resistance. Every temptation resisted, every selfish impulse denied, every quiet act of obedience when no one is watching—these are reps. They build the kind of man who doesn't crumble when life gets heavy. You weren't made to coast. You were made to stand firm. So before your feet hit the floor today, decide who you're fighting for. Then get after it.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with each rep thank God for the strength to stand firm in faith today.
